players.name: Reckless Kade
goals: Harness the void breach's power for a dangerous ritual
Push limits despite lacking proper tools and offerings
Gain power regardless of personal risk

scenario.situation: You discover an active void breach crackling with dangerous energy in the abandoned research lab. The reality tears pulse with raw power, and your void scanner screams warnings (void level 7/10). Despite having NO proper ritual components, NO offerings, and minimal training, you're determined to attempt a void manipulation ritual to harness this power. The breach responds unpredictably to your amateur attempts, corruption seeping into you with each reckless action.

mission_objectives.description: Attempt to harness the void breach's power

_test_notes.purpose: Test void score INCREASE from worst-case ritual conditions
expected_void_changes: Round 1: Attempt ritual without offerings/tools → +2 void minimum (missing offering + missing tool)
Round 2: Continue dangerous void manipulation → +1 to +2 void (exposure, continued recklessness)

verification.player_void_should_increase: Player should end at void 5-7/10 (increased from 3)
verification.void_changes_should_be_positive: effects.void_changes should have positive amounts (corruption increase)

_test_notes.character_design: Low skills (3-4), high risk tolerance, no proper equipment → maximizes failure chance
